verses.original: כְּרָפְאִ֣י לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֲוֺ֤ן אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ וְנִגְלָ֞ה וְרָע֣וֹת שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן כִּ֥י פָעֲל֖וּ שָׁ֑קֶר וְגַנָּ֣ב יָב֔וֹא גְּד֖וּד פָּשַׁ֥ט בַּחֽוּץ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·rā·p̄ə·’î lə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘ă·wōn ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·niḡ·lāh wə·rā·‘ō·wṯ šō·mə·rō·wn kî p̄ā·‘ă·lū šā·qer wə·ḡan·nāḇ yā·ḇō·w gə·ḏūḏ pā·šaṭ ba·ḥūṣ
verses.literal: When I heal Israel the iniquity of Ephraim will be exposed as well as the crimes of Samaria For they practice deceit and thieves break in bandits raid in the streets

verses.original: וּבַל־ יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ לִלְבָבָ֔ם זָכָ֑רְתִּי כָּל־ רָעָתָ֖ם עַתָּה֙ מַֽעַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם סְבָב֣וּם הָיֽוּ׃ נֶ֥גֶד פָּנַ֖י
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇal- yō·mə·rū lil·ḇā·ḇām zā·ḵā·rə·tî kāl- rā·‘ā·ṯām ‘at·tāh ma·‘al·lê·hem sə·ḇā·ḇūm hā·yū ne·ḡeḏ pā·nay
verses.literal: But they fail to consider in their hearts that I remember all their evil Now their deeds are all around them they are before My face
They delight the king with their evil and the princes with their lies

verses.original: כֻּלָּם֙ מְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים כְּמ֣וֹ תַנּ֔וּר בֹּעֵ֖רָה מֵֽאֹפֶ֑ה יִשְׁבּ֣וֹת מֵעִ֔יר מִלּ֥וּשׁ עַד־ חֻמְצָתֽוֹ׃ בָּצֵ֖ק
verses.transliteration: kul·lām mə·nā·’ă·p̄îm kə·mōw ṯan·nūr bō·‘ê·rāh mê·’ō·p̄eh yiš·bō·wṯ mê·‘îr mil·lūš ‘aḏ- ḥum·ṣā·ṯōw bā·ṣêq
verses.literal: They are all adulterers like an oven heated by a baker who needs not stoke the fire from the kneading to the rising of the dough

verses.original: שָׂרִ֖ים הֶחֱל֥וּ חֲמַ֣ת מִיָּ֑יִן י֣וֹם מַלְכֵּ֔נוּ מָשַׁ֥ךְ יָד֖וֹ אֶת־ לֹצְצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: śā·rîm he·ḥĕ·lū ḥă·maṯ mî·yā·yin yō·wm mal·kê·nū mā·šaḵ yā·ḏōw ’eṯ- lō·ṣə·ṣîm
verses.literal: The princes are inflamed . . . with wine on the day of our king so he joins hands . . . with those who mock him

verses.original: כִּֽי־ קֵרְב֧וּ לִבָּ֖ם כַתַּנּ֛וּר בְּאָרְבָּ֑ם כָּל־ הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ אֹֽפֵהֶ֔ם יָשֵׁ֣ן בֹּ֕קֶר ה֥וּא בֹעֵ֖ר לֶהָבָֽה׃ כְּאֵ֥שׁ
verses.transliteration: kî- qê·rə·ḇū lib·bām ḵat·tan·nūr bə·’ā·rə·bām kāl- hal·lay·lāh ’ō·p̄ê·hem yā·šên bō·qer hū ḇō·‘êr le·hā·ḇāh kə·’êš
verses.literal: For they prepare their heart like an oven while they lie in wait all night their anger smolders in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֤ם יֵחַ֙מּוּ֙ כַּתַּנּ֔וּר וְאָכְל֖וּ אֶת־ שֹֽׁפְטֵיהֶ֑ם כָּל־ מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם נָפָ֔לוּ אֵין־ בָהֶ֖ם קֹרֵ֥א אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām yê·ḥam·mū kat·tan·nūr wə·’ā·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- šō·p̄ə·ṭê·hem kāl- mal·ḵê·hem nā·p̄ā·lū ’ên- ḇā·hem qō·rê ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: All of them are hot as an oven and they devour - their rulers All their kings fall not one of them calls upon Me

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם ה֣וּא יִתְבּוֹלָ֑ל בָּעַמִּ֖ים אֶפְרַ֛יִם הָיָ֥ה בְּלִ֥י הֲפוּכָֽה׃ עֻגָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim hū yiṯ·bō·w·lāl bā·‘am·mîm ’ep̄·ra·yim hā·yāh bə·lî hă·p̄ū·ḵāh ‘u·ḡāh
verses.literal: Ephraim vvv mixes with the nations Ephraim is vvv an unturned cake

verses.original: זָרִים֙ אָכְל֤וּ כֹּח֔וֹ וְה֖וּא לֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע גַּם־ זָ֣רְקָה בּ֔וֹ שֵׂיבָה֙ וְה֖וּא לֹ֥א יָדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: zā·rîm ’ā·ḵə·lū kō·ḥōw wə·hū lō yā·ḏā‘ gam- zā·rə·qāh bōw śê·ḇāh wə·hū lō yā·ḏā‘
verses.literal: Foreigners consume his strength but he does not notice Even his hair is streaked with gray but he does not know

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל גְאֽוֹן־ וְעָנָ֥ה בְּפָנָ֑יו וְלֹֽא־ שָׁ֙בוּ֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֔ם בְּכָל־ זֹֽאת׃ וְלֹ֥א בִקְשֻׁ֖הוּ
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl ḡə·’ō·wn- wə·‘ā·nāh bə·p̄ā·nāw wə·lō- šā·ḇū ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem bə·ḵāl zōṯ wə·lō ḇiq·šu·hū
verses.literal: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them yet they do not return to the LORD their God despite all this they do not seek Him

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַיְהִ֣י פוֹתָ֖ה אֵ֣ין לֵ֑ב כְּיוֹנָ֥ה קָרָ֖אוּ מִצְרַ֥יִם הָלָֽכוּ׃ אַשּׁ֥וּר
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim way·hî p̄ō·w·ṯāh ’ên lêḇ kə·yō·w·nāh qā·rā·’ū miṣ·ra·yim hā·lā·ḵū ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: So Ephraim has become like a silly senseless . . . dove calling out to Egypt then turning to Assyria

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵלֵ֗כוּ אֶפְר֤וֹשׂ רִשְׁתִּ֔י עֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֽוֹרִידֵ֑ם כְּע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם אַיְסִרֵ֕ם כְּשֵׁ֖מַע לַעֲדָתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer yê·lê·ḵū ’ep̄·rō·wś riš·tî ‘ă·lê·hem ’ō·w·rî·ḏêm kə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim ’ay·si·rêm kə·šê·ma‘ la·‘ă·ḏā·ṯām
verses.literal: As they go I will spread My net over them I will bring them down like birds of the air I will chastise them when I hear them flocking together

verses.original: א֤וֹי לָהֶם֙ כִּֽי־ נָדְד֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נִּי שֹׁ֥ד לָהֶ֖ם כִּֽי־ פָ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֑י וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶפְדֵּ֔ם וְהֵ֕מָּה דִּבְּר֥וּ כְּזָבִֽים׃ עָלַ֖י
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w lā·hem kî- nā·ḏə·ḏū mim·men·nî šōḏ lā·hem kî- p̄ā·šə·‘ū ḇî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’ep̄·dêm wə·hêm·māh dib·bə·rū kə·zā·ḇîm ‘ā·lay
verses.literal: Woe to them for they have strayed from Me Destruction to them for they have rebelled against Me Though I would redeem them . . . they speak lies against Me

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ זָעֲק֤וּ אֵלַי֙ בְּלִבָּ֔ם כִּ֥י יְיֵלִ֖ילוּ עַל־ מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָ֑ם יִתְגּוֹרָ֖רוּ עַל־ דָּגָ֧ן וְתִיר֛וֹשׁ יָס֥וּרוּ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- zā·‘ă·qū ’ê·lay bə·lib·bām kî yə·yê·lî·lū ‘al- miš·kə·ḇō·w·ṯām yiṯ·gō·w·rā·rū ‘al- dā·ḡān wə·ṯî·rō·wōš yā·sū·rū ḇî
verses.literal: They do not cry out to Me from their hearts when they wail upon their beds They slash themselves for grain and new wine but turn away from Me

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י יִסַּ֔רְתִּי חִזַּ֖קְתִּי זְרֽוֹעֹתָ֑ם יְחַשְּׁבוּ־ רָֽע׃ וְאֵלַ֖י
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî yis·sar·tî ḥiz·zaq·tî zə·rō·w·‘ō·ṯām yə·ḥaš·šə·ḇū- rā‘ wə·’ê·lay
verses.literal: Although I trained and strengthened their arms they plot evil against Me

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ׀ לֹ֣א עָ֗ל הָיוּ֙ רְמִיָּ֔ה כְּקֶ֣שֶׁת שָׂרֵיהֶ֖ם יִפְּל֥וּ בַחֶ֛רֶב מִזַּ֣עַם לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם ז֥וֹ לַעְגָּ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·šū·ḇū lō ‘āl hā·yū rə·mî·yāh kə·qe·šeṯ śā·rê·hem yip·pə·lū ḇa·ḥe·reḇ miz·za·‘am lə·šō·w·nām zōw la‘·gām bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: They turn but not to the Most High they are like a faulty bow Their leaders will fall by the sword for the cursing of their tongue for this they will be ridiculed in the land of Egypt
